import hashlib, json, os, pathlib, select, subprocess, sys, time

root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
journal_path = root / 'examples/proof_nodes/proof_journals/common-obj-relations-2026-10-05.json'
journal_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
journal = json.loads(journal_path.read_text()) if journal_path.exists() else {'sessions': []}
binary = root / 'target/release/litex'
record = {'binary_sha256': hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'command': [str(binary), '-strict', '-e', '1=1', '-session'], 'probes': []}
journal['sessions'].append(record)
p = subprocess.Popen(record['command'], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)

def read_frame():
    data = b''
    end = time.monotonic() + 45
    while time.monotonic() < end:
        readable, _, _ = select.select([p.stdout], [], [], 1)
        if readable:
            chunk = os.read(p.stdout.fileno(), 65536)
            if not chunk:
                return data.decode(), False
            data += chunk
            if data.endswith(b'litex> '):
                return data.decode(), True
    raise TimeoutError(data.decode())

record['startup'], ready = read_frame()
assert ready, record['startup']
print('READY', flush=True)
for line in sys.stdin:
    item = json.loads(line)
    if item.get('exit'):
        break
    code = item['code'].strip() + '\n'
    p.stdin.write((code + '\n').encode()); p.stdin.flush()
    raw, ready = read_frame()
    accepted = raw.endswith('success\nlitex> ')
    row = {'id': item['id'], 'code': code, 'raw': raw, 'accepted': accepted, 'session_alive': ready}
    record['probes'].append(row)
    journal_path.write_text(json.dumps(journal, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps({'id': item['id'], 'accepted': accepted, 'alive': ready, 'raw_bytes': len(raw)}, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
    if not ready:
        break
p.stdin.write(b'exit\n') if p.poll() is None else None
if p.poll() is None:
    p.stdin.flush()
    record['close_output'] = p.communicate(timeout=10)[0].decode()
record['exit_code'] = p.returncode
journal_path.write_text(json.dumps(journal, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')

]

for i, code in enumerate(negative):
    rows.append({'id': f'negative_{i}', 'code': code, 'expected': False, 'command': [str(binary), '-strict', '-e', code]})

    p = subprocess.run(row['command'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=45)
    try: envelope = json.loads(p.stdout)
    except json.JSONDecodeError: envelope = None
    row.update(exit_code=p.returncode, stdout=p.stdout, stderr=p.stderr,
               success=None if envelope is None else envelope.get('success'))
    row['consistent'] = envelope is not None and row['success'] == row['expected'] and ((p.returncode == 0) == row['expected'])
    print(json.dumps({k:row[k] for k in ['id','exit_code','success','consistent']}), flush=True)
after = hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
record = {'binary_before': before, 'binary_after': after, 'binary_stable': before==after, 'rows': rows}
(root/'tmp/2026-10-05/common-obj-relations/cold-gates.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2)+'\n')
assert before == after and all(r['consistent'] for r in rows)
